end_time.description: end timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, now, now-<duration>, now+<duration> (e.g. now-1h), or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to current time.

matches.description: series selector arguments to filter label names

start_time.description: start timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, now, now-<duration>, now+<duration> (e.g. now-1h), or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to 5m ago.

truncation_limit.description: truncation limit for query response in number of lines/entries; use lower limits (e.g. 50-100) for initial exploration, set to -1 to disable truncation
